Apūpa is the general word from the Rigveda onwards for a cake, which might be mixed with ghee (ghṛtavant), or be made of rice (vrīhi), or of barley (yava). In the Chāndogya upaniṣad there is a difference of interpretation. Max Müller renders it as ‘hive,’ Bo7htlingk as ‘honeycomb,’ Little as ‘cake.’
